name: Filesystem MCP
description: Official Anthropic MCP server for local filesystem operations. Exposes read, write, search, and directory-listing tools scoped to user-specified allowed directories.

doc_quality.notes: Comprehensive documentation with setup, allowed-directory configuration, security model explanation, and all tool schemas defined. One of the best-documented servers in the ecosystem.

auth_security.notes: Security model is directory-scoping rather than authentication. Allowed directories are configured at launch. No credentials involved, but path-traversal protection is manually enforced rather than OS-level sandboxed.

tool_coverage.notes: 11 tools: read_file, read_multiple_files, write_file, edit_file, create_directory, list_directory, directory_tree, move_file, search_files, get_file_info, list_allowed_directories. Solid coverage of real-world file workflows.

reliability.notes: Deterministic local operations with clear error messages for permission violations and missing files. No network dependency. Highly stable across Claude Desktop versions.

community.notes: First-party Anthropic server, ships with Claude Desktop out of the box. Highest star count and issue activity in the MCP servers repository.
